entries.hint: Travelers speak of a walled city beyond the eastern marshes, where the river meets the sea.
The lift's engineers whisper of galleries below the deepest seam — worked once, sealed, and never mapped.
Beneath the Guardian's barrow, the scholar insists, older passages wait — sealed, not empty.
Beyond Frostmere the ridge climbs into peaks no ledger names, and something glitters on the far side of the ice.
